extDescription.message: Preview any website at phone sizes inside a device frame. Free and open source, no debugger banner.

actionTitle.message: Open or close Viewport in this tab

returnNote.message: Click the Viewport icon again to return this tab to the website.

overlayGrant.message: Click “Allow website access” in the right panel.

statusGrant.message: Viewport needs a one-time permission to show websites inside the phone frame. It replaces the debugger, so there is no banner.

statusReady.message: Connected · Direct mode, no debugger. Click, scroll, type and paste right on the phone screen.

overlayEmpty.message: Type a website address in the bar above.

statusEmpty.message: Type a website address in the bar above, then press Enter.

errorNotExtension.message: Open the studio from the extension icon in Chrome, not from a preview server.

errorDenied.message: Permission denied. Websites cannot appear in the phone frame without it.

errorUrl.message: Use an http/https URL without credentials.

errorWebStore.message: The Chrome Web Store cannot be tested with extensions.

errorSize.message: Viewport size must be 240–2000 CSS px.

errorPermission.message: Website access has not been granted yet.

errorNoSession.message: No active session. Reload this page.
